REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - FEBRUARY 22, 2024 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or by using the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

9A.  Review and consideration of the feasibility of converting two tennis courts at Liberty Park

  pickleball courts on the east part of the City (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Dario Simoes, Acting Public Works Director/City Engineer. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor Pro Tem opened the public comments period.

  Written Correspondence:

  The following individuals expressed support for the installation of pickleball courts at

  Sambhav Desai
  Shalva Krish
  Shashi Kadambi
  Preman Kizhakkedath
  Murali Vasudevan

  In-Person Public Comments:

  Teddy Lloyd thanked the City Council for their work in advancing the sport of pickleball in
  Cerritos and offered to provide information concerning the construction of courts and the
  feasibility of various locations throughout the City.

  Sam Desai spoke in support of the installation of pickleball courts at Cerritos Park East
  (CPE).

  Mel Cortez spoke in support of the installation of pickleball courts at Cerritos Park East
  (CPE).

(minutes continue on the next page)

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9A.  (continued)

  Pat Patnaik stated the Parks and Recreation Commission recently voted unanimously to
  recommend that the City Council approve the conversion of one tennis court at Liberty park
  to four (4) pickleball courts and suggested a feasibility study for the east side of the City.

  Seeing no further speakers, the Mayor Pro Tem declared the public comments period
  closed.

  MOTION (FAILED DUE TO TIE VOTE): It was moved by Johnson, and seconded by
  Yokoyama, to:

  1. Construct two (2) new dedicated pickleball courts at an estimated cost of $80,000 on
  the south side of Liberty Park, adjacent to the south playground, at the previous site of
  a picnic shelter removed in 2012, by changing the scope of Capital Improvement
  Project 10804, resulting in a savings of approximately $20,000; and

  2. Pursuant to the recommendation by the Parks and Recreation Commission, convert one
  (1) tennis court at Liberty Park to four (4) stand-alone pickleball courts and not
  recommend dual use of the courts (COUNCIL).

  The motion failed (2 – 2 – 1 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Yokoyama
  NOES:  Vo, Solanki
  ABSENT:  Barrows (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

  PROPOSED MOTION (WITHDRAWN BY MAKER): The motion made by Johnson to
  construct two (2) new dedicated pickleball courts at an estimated cost of $80,000 on the
  south side of Liberty Park, adjacent to the south playground, at the previous site of a picnic
  shelter removed in 2012, by changing the scope of Capital Improvement Project 10804,
  resulting in a savings of approximately $20,000, was withdrawn by the maker.

  ORIGINAL MAIN MOTION (HELD PENDING): It was moved by Vo, and seconded by
  Solanki, to:

  1. Construct two (2) new dedicated pickleball courts at an estimated cost of $80,000 on
  the south side of Liberty Park, adjacent to the south playground, at the previous site of
  a picnic shelter removed in 2012, by changing the scope of Capital Improvement
  Project 10804, resulting in a savings of approximately $20,000; and

  2. Direct the City Manager to provide information to the City Council concerning the
  feasibility of installing pickleball courts on the east side of Cerritos at any site deemed
  appropriate for the City Council to consider, including Cerritos Park East (CPE) as one of
  the main options (COUNCIL).

  (The main motion was held pending due to consideration of a potential substitute motion.)

(minutes continue on the next page)

  estimated cost of $80,000 on the south side of Liberty Park, adjacent to the south
  playground, at the previous site of a picnic shelter removed in 2012, by changing the scope
  of Capital Improvement Project 10804, resulting in a savings of approximately $20,000;
  and 2.) Direct the City Manager to provide information to the City Council concerning the
  feasibility of installing pickleball courts on the east side of Cerritos at Cerritos Park East
  (CPE) only, failed due to lack of a second.

  ORIGINAL MAIN MOTION (CARRIED): It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Solanki, to:

  1. Construct two (2) new dedicated pickleball courts at an estimated cost of $80,000 on
  the south side of Liberty Park, adjacent to the south playground, at the previous site of
  a picnic shelter removed in 2012, by changing the scope of Capital Improvement
  Project 10804, resulting in a savings of approximately $20,000; and

  feasibility of installing pickleball courts on the east side of Cerritos at any site deemed
  appropriate for the City Council to consider, including Cerritos Park East (CPE) as one of
  the main options (COUNCIL).
